title: Human Anatomy and Physiology Laboratory Manual: Understanding How Structure Determines Function
description: This lab manual introduces students to Human Anatomy and Physiology concepts. The laboratory exercises contain applied activities and experiments to help students visualize anatomical structures and relate them to specific functions and the complex physiological events that allow us to maintain homeostasis.
